correctness.rationale: For odd p^f, cyclic unit group of order 2^s u has exactly 2^(t−1)u elements with ord 2-adic valuation t. Solubility of a^n=−1 locally iff order even, with n≡ord(a)/2 mod ord(a); CRT and least common multiple show all odd local orders must have the same positive 2-adic valuation. Their product counts yield (∏u_i)∑_{j=0}^{s*−1}2^(r j) for e≤1. If e≥2, any solution has n odd from reduction mod4; odd power map bijects the 2-primary unit group, forcing a=−1 on that factor and valuation t=1 everywhere else, yielding ∏u_i including empty product. The first exponent is half the global order. Independently brute-forced every modulus 3..250 with direct power orbit enumeration and compared counts. Infinite validity rests on group theory/CRT, not finite census.
